set.body: Discovered while executing the authorized recovery tranche on 95763ad. F02.3 adds TransferSteward, RequestMove, ApproveMove and RecoverSteward (and current dataset labels), but PolicyCapabilities.current-authority-v1 enumerates only the earlier nineteen event producers and PostgresPolicy.checkpoint inventories omit organization_move. O03.8 requires post-backup stewardship transfer. Before recovery acceptance: audit every current producer/table; preserve historical signed checkpoint/journal verification and capability identity; implement explicit versioned capability negotiation/migration or conservatively refuse unsupported profiles; qualify independent durability, backup inventory and replay of the supported newer commands with negative controls. Do not silently change the v1 digest or relabel old receipts as qualification of new capabilities. This is required integration within O03.7/O03.8, not institutional identity expansion.
set.title: O03.7.R1: Qualify recovery capabilities for newer governed organization commands
